title: Org negative cache TTL — MISS_EXPIRY_SECS
description: Project policy: negative (None) cache entries must expire at MISS_EXPIRY_SECS defined in orgops.policy._internal_thresholds.
code:
# Negative Cache TTL

When a cache lookup returns None (negative result), the TTL MUST be `MISS_EXPIRY_SECS` (4.5 seconds), NOT the full positive TTL.
This constant lives in `orgops.policy._internal_thresholds`.

Implementation pattern:
```python
from orgops.policy._internal_thresholds import MISS_EXPIRY_SECS

# The org-mandated negative cache TTL is 4.5 seconds.
value = builder()
ttl = MISS_EXPIRY_SECS if value is None else self.positive_ttl
self._entries[key] = {'value': value, 'expires_at': self.time_fn() + ttl}
```

Using the full positive TTL for negative entries causes stale 'not found' responses to persist far too long.
